source: CEPII BACI V202601, based on UN Comtrade

711011.title: Platinum, unwrought or in powder form
711011.boundary: Refined/semi form; exporters include UK/Swiss/German refining hubs, not just mines.

711021.title: Palladium, unwrought or in powder form
711021.boundary: Refined form; Russia and South Africa are the mine base, but trade routes through hubs.

711031.title: Rhodium, unwrought or in powder form
711031.boundary: Small, volatile market; a South-African platinum by-product.

711510.title: Catalysts of platinum (wire cloth / grill)
711510.boundary: One catalyst form; most autocatalyst value is in coated ceramic, not this heading.
